rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: To speak in confounded sounds that no hearer shares
content.ART_PROMPT: An unfinished brick tower at the moment of confusion, abandoned scaffolding and dropped tools, bricks tumbling from a half-laid course, great flocks of birds bursting upward from the tower like scattered words, only tiny distant figures far below walking away in every direction with backs turned, no faces, engraved devotional style on warm parchment tones
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Reveal one card from the top of the Tower and add that revealed card to your hand. Then shuffle the cards in the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: the LORD did there confound the language
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: the multitude came together, and were confounded
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 11:9 — “the LORD did there confound the language”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Acts 2:6 — “the multitude came together, and were confounded”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Genesis 11:9 names Babel from balal, to confound - a Hebrew pun on Babylon's own name.
The Greek Old Testament renders balal with syncheo, the very word Acts 2 uses when the crowd was confounded.
English babble is not from Babel - it imitates a baby's first sounds - but the two have kept company since Chaucer.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Every filled pip is one flat, solid, uniformly dark navy disc with no highlight, gloss, gradient, inner ring, or concentric texture; every empty pip is a thin navy outline with plain parchment interior. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
